title: Delay is not dispersion
question: On a preregistered common-support subset of ISLES'24 tissue curves, does one frozen raw-temporal final-infarct surrogate respond consistently across alternative realistic operators that reduce delay-independent bolus dispersion while preserving arrival time, area, and peak height?
deliverable_original: The final-infarct model is using delay-independent bolus dispersion as a collateral-route signal.
deliverable_sentence: Within the validated common-support regime, one frozen raw-temporal ISLES'24 final-infarct surrogate uses an operator-invariant, delay-independent bolus-dispersion shape signal rather than arrival delay or amplitude.
rung: Target rung 1 only: causal use by one frozen surrogate within the validated low-dose common-support regime. Collateral-route physiology, clinical utility, other models, and tissue outside that regime are outside the claim.
X_measurement: On the exact series consumed by the surrogate, baseline-subtract each curve, identify arrival with a frozen automatic arterial-input procedure, align arrival, and measure spreading by second central moment (primary). Skewness, tail-area fraction, kurtosis, maximum slopes, and temporal spectral energy are mandatory characterization. Operators and descriptors are fixed before inference; no new annotation is needed.
suspected_signal: Bolus delay and dispersion are distinct transport properties. A raw-temporal model may use post-alignment spreading that conventional delay summaries conflate with late arrival. The uncertainty is model behavior, not whether ISLES'24 can establish collateral causation.
keystone_prerequisite: Released CTP must capture the bolus sufficiently for stable dispersion measurement, and the fixed-arrival/fixed-area/fixed-peak same-case curve manifold must support realistic low-dose dispersion reduction by at least two alternative operators on enough untouched cases and voxels for a powered paired test.
keystone_residual_assumption: Primary sources verify 4D CTP and 1-frame/sec resampling, not bolus coverage, original timing, moment stability, manifold dimensionality, edit headroom, or common-support size. Model-blind Stage 0 must inspect them. Failure of any frozen gate kills the use experiment and is not evidence of non-use.
verified_dataset_facts: The realized cohort is 245 adults from two centers: 149 public training and 96 hidden test cases (Riedel et al., Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2026, DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603).

Cases include acute pre-intervention NCCT, CTA, 4D CTP, and derived CBF, CBV, MTT and Tmax maps; released CTP was co-registered and resampled to 1 frame/sec (DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603; Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16731717).

Final-infarct masks were derived from follow-up DWI acquired 2-9 days after successful reperfusion using DeepISLES followed by neuroradiologist-supervised correction (DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603; arXiv:2408.10966).

The 149-case release is public via Zenodo under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with no DUA; the inspected distribution is an approximately 99 GB monolithic archive (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16731717; evidence/datasets.csv, verified 2026-08-18).

Official measures are Dice, absolute lesion-volume difference, absolute lesion-count difference, and lesion-wise F1; they gate segmentation performance but are not the mechanistic endpoint (https://github.com/ezequieldlrosa/isles24; arXiv:2408.10966).
use_vs_association: Association is a model-blind prerequisite: within narrow delay strata, dispersion must vary and add held-out final-infarct discrimination beyond delay. Use is tested only afterward. On frozen subset S, two independently specified, same-case-supported operators make matched low-dose moves along the validated dispersion trajectory while holding arrival, area, and peak fixed. A matched-cost delay edit is the positive control. The confirmatory conjunction requires dose-ordered affected-tissue output change exceeding delay response for each operator and concordant signed response across operators. One operator alone licenses only operator-specific sensitivity.
manifold_and_operator_gate: Before model query, compare prespecified one- and multi-dimensional descriptions of unedited same-case curves conditional on arrival, area, and peak. Continue only if held-out reconstruction and descriptor residuals support an effectively one-dimensional monotonic trajectory over the low-dose range, with orthogonal residuals below a repeatability bound frozen in feasibility. Construct at least two alternative operators reaching matched coordinate changes. S contains only voxels where both operators and delay control pass identical full-descriptor neighbor-support and headroom gates at every dose. Freeze minimum cases and per-case voxel fraction from a power analysis before inference.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Phase 0A inspects 20 cases without model inference: require at least five pre-arrival frames, arterial peak at least five frames before the end, washout to at most 30% of peak, timing provenance, dispersion ICC at least 0.85 under two arterial-input selections, and frame-decimation stability. Phase 0B estimates the manifold, builds two low-dose peak-preserving operators, freezes S, and runs association and power gates. Only then freeze one minimally adequate surrogate and untouched evaluation cases. Primary endpoint is paired affected-tissue prediction-mass dose response under the operator-concordant conjunction. Exact cases, doses, margins, support thresholds, split, performance gate, and equivalence bounds require a reviewed feasibility memo.
standing_confounds_addressed: Within-case edits hold patient, center, scanner, injection, cardiac output, anatomy, treatment and global arterial curve fixed. Arrival, area and peak invariance exclude simple delay and amplitude on S; matched delay tests generic transport sensitivity; alternative-operator concordance tests operator artifacts; descriptor support constrains edits to the observed family. Preprocessing may still have written the signal, the manifold operationalizes rather than proves physiology, and one surrogate does not generalize.
alternative_explanations: Response comes from one operator's tail, slope, kurtosis, or spectral artifact; matched alternative-operator agreement tests this, and failure prevents a dispersion claim.
Co-registration or resampling created the spreading; the claim concerns use of the released-series signal, not its biological source.
The surrogate reacts to any temporal edit; matched delay and a support-matched sham must show smaller response.
Dispersion is associated with infarction but unused; only the intervention endpoint distinguishes use.
anticipated_negative: If capture, repeatability, manifold, support, association, performance, positive-control, power, and realism gates pass, an equivalence-bounded lack of operator-concordant response rejects use of this dispersion-family signal by the tested surrogate within S. Operator disagreement instead rejects the broader dispersion interpretation and records operator-specific sensitivity. Failed prerequisites and underpowered nulls are sensitivity-limited.
dies_like_prior: This remains exposed to IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE. Unlike prior killed mechanism claims, it requires model-blind evidence of an effectively one-dimensional conditional curve family and concordance across alternative operators; otherwise it stops at operator-specific sensitivity. It supersedes scouting predecessor isles24-scout-003-c06. It inherits idea-022's checkpoint risk and idea-041's surrogate dependency; no qualifying public checkpoint is verified.
closest_prior_work: Calamante et al. (DOI 10.1002/mrm.20873; PMID 16598717) separates delay from dispersion. Willats et al. (DOI 10.1161/STROKEAHA.111.635888) studies dispersion effects in tissue prediction. Winder et al. (DOI 10.3389/fnins.2022.1009654; PMCID PMC9672821) trains raw-curve outcome models without this intervention. Amador et al. (DOI 10.1109/ISBI56570.2024.10635756) analyzes attention to temporal patterns; accessible primary metadata describes attention analysis, not causal curve perturbation. Its full text requires inspection before any novelty statement.
novelty_delta: No novelty is claimed. A targeted search located no study combining invariant low-dose edits, model-blind manifold validation, and alternative-operator concordance in a raw-CTP infarct model. This is not proof of absence; full Amador inspection and systematic audit remain.
existing_assets: The public 149-case archive supplies 4D CTP and expert-corrected final masks; deterministic moment and transport methods and raw-temporal model designs exist. No verified reusable checkpoint, edit operator, manifold procedure, or common-support subset exists.
remaining_legwork: Inspect the approximately 99 GB archive and timing metadata; read Amador in full; reproduce measurements; freeze repeatability, manifold and support thresholds; design two distinct operators; perform cluster-aware power analysis; and obtain or train one surrogate. Honest cost is multiple stages, about 100 GB storage and likely tens of GPU-hours.
entry_point_2_requirements: Measurement: preregistered dispersion coordinate on aligned curves. Confused artifacts: delay, amplitude, operator shape, truncation, resampling and generic edit sensitivity. Invariance, delay control, full-descriptor support, alternative operators and capture gates address them only within S.
annotation_burden: No new expert annotation; released neuroradiologist-supervised masks support training and performance gating.
prohibited_conclusions: that collateral routes caused the curve shape
that the surrogate computes a particular descriptor
that tissue outside S or large edits behave similarly
that another model or challenge winner uses the signal

clarity.why: The question and conjunction are precise, though the manifold gate is substantial.

identifiability.why: Operator agreement targets the debate objection, but manifold interpretation and signal provenance remain unverified.

medical_relevance.why: Separating curve spreading from lateness matters for interpreting raw-CTP outcome models.

interest.why: Operator-invariant use would be informative; disagreement exposes counterfactual invalidity.

prior_legwork.why: Physics, models and data exist, but the decisive manifold, operators and checkpoint do not.

feasibility.why: Archive inspection, two-operator construction, power analysis and likely training make this multi-stage.

data_readiness.why: Data are public but monolithic; timing and bolus coverage are uninspected.

evaluation_readiness.why: Segmentation metrics exist, but support, equivalence and mechanistic endpoints are custom.

negative_result_value.why: A powered gated null rejects use for one surrogate in S; early stops remain uninformative.

novelty_confidence.why: A close paper needs full inspection and no systematic audit exists.

regret.why: The distinction is clean if support exists, but the portfolio already has many counterfactuals.

unverified_claims: adequate bolus capture and timing metadata
stable dispersion under AIF choice and frame decimation
an effectively one-dimensional conditional curve manifold
the novelty gap beyond targeted search
plain_pitch: Late contrast arrival and spread-out passage are different. This study first checks whether the stroke curves support two realistic ways to reduce spreading without changing arrival time or brightness. Only if both edits agree on the same low-dose tissue subset does it ask whether one frozen surrogate responds more than to an equal time shift. A gated null rejects use by that surrogate; edit disagreement warns that the apparent mechanism belongs to the editing method.
